derivation: prolongation from the same base as G5567 (ψάλλω);
def: to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand)

occurrences.text: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
